test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: K, L, M, N, O and Q are sitting in a straight line facing North (but not necessarily in the same order). Only three students are sitting between Q and N. M has K and L as his immediate neighbours. K is second to the right of O. L is second to the right of K. N is to the immediate right of L. Q is to the immediate right of O. Who among the following has K and O as his immediate neighbours?
solution:
Given: K, L, M, N, O and Q are sitting in a straight line facing North.

1) Only three students are sitting between Q and N. 

2) Q is to the immediate right of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d1765a4a6276e3ccb02e83d7456cd900a9a8bbe03b1abec0db820a055610b4c.png] 

3) K is second to the right of O.

4) L is second to the right of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd1f82e57fe4867b768fa3102fe969732a04579515b1ce6c9a0bb1f9918637c1.png] 

5) N is to the immediate right of L.

6) M has K and L as his immediate neighbours. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9efcd8ae6e3e84b31286ee54b3ad763e5d297f6d28133cb6ce03c993bc44fd7.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, Q has K and O as his immediate neighbours.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
